question: For the first eligible H4 n31 curve, what exact cofactor-cleared prime-subgroup base and first-pair index result, and what three-sum lookup yield occurs on 32 fixed fresh subgroup targets?

instance.selection_rule: first index among 0,1,2 with largest prime divisor at least 2^25

base_rule: reconstruct exact selected curve and 11-vector x-subspace; enumerate every curve lift, multiply by 62, remove identity and duplicates, sort encoded coordinates; retain direct eligibility and duplicate counts
index_rule: attempt every ordered pair of cleared base points; keep first pair per distinct group sum; record pair attempts, stored sums, wall time and observed peak RSS
target_law: 32 indexed SHA256-derived nonzero scalars h4-n31-instance1-target-i modulo r, multiplied by first nonzero cleared point solely to construct public target fixtures
lookup_rule: for each public point scan all cleared base points in sorted order, test residual in first-pair index, verify first witness by group law or record complete exhaustion; retain every outcome and lookup interval
host: ordinary local macOS checked Sage; algorithmic diagnostic
claim_boundary: n31 field/base/index diagnostic on a 34635389-order subgroup; subgroup order and cofactor differ from n29, so timings and yield are not a fixed-group scaling comparison
